title: $1,000 in Amazon in 2008 is now worth this
caption:
In 2008, Amazon was selling online in a recession.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:AMZN:2008-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Amazon in 2008? 👇
sources: Amazon price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
